frozen_design.input: Append8 normalized controller observations only to historical encoder rows:3postintegrals,3publishedcompressiongains,2publicationages. No appended rollout features, future controller signals, recovered airspeed scaling, or additional targets.
frozen_design.architecture: Same unit-gravity GRU64 rate-reference model; encoder input25->33 only, total41606parameters (+1536). Cell/head/derivative bounds/phase schedule unchanged. Both arms use identical enlarged architecture.
frozen_design.initialization: Instantiate original v23 model under each original seed first. Copy every original parameter into enlarged model, append8 all-zero columns to encoder weight_ih_l0; copy all other encoder weights/biases. Same initial trainable weights between arms; check initial predictions against original implementation.
frozen_design.zero_control: Zero the appended8 channels AFTER normalization. This preserves identical parameter capacity without conveying controller information. Rerun all15 zero-control fits; frozenv23 is secondary reference, not the sole capacity control.
frozen_design.normalization: Use prepared fold*/controller_normalization.npz fitted only on unique historical rows in the4fitflights. All v23 state/reference/actuator/label normalization unchanged.
frozen_design.pairing: Identical v8/v23 stored1600x32 draws and common initial weights for each fold/seed, AdamWlr3e-4 wd1e-4 clip1, original full1s loss, no q first-step auxiliary loss. Fixed final checkpoint.
frozen_design.primary: q complete1s OOF waveform RMSE: >=5% mean flight/seed improvement vs zero arm, all3seeds positive, >=4/5flights positive.
frozen_design.protections: p/r full1s waveform and velocity/attitude .5/1s endpoints no>5% regression per seed, same flight-equal aggregation asv23. Report p/q<=.15rad/s,attitude<=3deg,velocity<=.5m/s at.5s on unchanged original active windows for every seed.
frozen_design.evaluation: Fit and OOF, horizons20ms/100ms/.5s/1s, original modes/flight strata retained. Held rate3/thrust diagnostic optional only if frozen before launch; no feedback future state as known input.
frozen_design.causal_checks: All observation publications<=each historical query<=origin; altering messages afterorigin must not change history. Future reference suffix cannot alter earlier predictions. No hidden normalization fit on query flights.
frozen_design.limitations: Tests the joint block of observed integral/compression/age information, not separate causal contributions. Published gains are stale observations and do not restore all spectral/filter states. The conditional rate-reference task still differs from an exogenous attitude-input task.
frozen_design.decision: If primary/protections fail, retainA1600 and v23 as research baselines; do not alterthresholds, deletewindows, scancoefficients or promotecontrol. If numericalgatespass, proceed only to independent control-response/closed-loop evidence, never automatic deployment.
